issue.description:
AGENTS.md's compatibility section states `.beads/issues.jsonl` is an interchange checkpoint, while every documented durability path uses `.beads/checkpoint/` content-addressed JSONL objects, and ADR-002 restricts native recovery import to the self-describing checkpoint emitted by bead-rs. Nothing in the documentation defines which command reads or writes a flat issues.jsonl in a bead-rs workspace, and surrounding fleet guidance treats a flat issues.jsonl as evidence of the legacy backend — so an agent relying on the AGENTS.md bullet expects an interchange surface that may not exist. Decide and record the resolution: either implement an explicit, versioned issues.jsonl interchange export/import with round-trip unknown-field-preservation tests per the compatibility rules, or correct AGENTS.md to describe the actual interchange surface. Keep native behavior from silently emulating a legacy profile either way.

---
Priority: P3
Created by: weave strand
issue.title: Reconcile the `.beads/issues.jsonl` interchange-checkpoint claim in AGENTS.md with the checkpoint-directory implementation
